integrity: Proof uses explicit inclusion-exclusion, exact discrete convexity and gap smoothing; finite exhaustive computations are supporting checks only; publication priority and independent validation remain open.
scientific_limitations: Finite undirected cycles, uniform-cost static controllers and exchangeable vertex removals independent of placement; expected served count only, not worst-case risk or stochastic dominance.
title: Universal gap balancing for cyclic controller networks under exchangeable vertex failures
